name: Brazen Serpent
overview: The Brazen Serpent was crafted by Moses as a means for the Israelites to find physical healing when bitten by serpents, as described in Numbers 21:9. However, this object later became an item of worship among the people, illustrating a misplaced reverence. In the New Testament, Jesus Christ is identified as the ultimate fulfillment of this symbol, being 'lifted up' so that all who believe in Him receive eternal life, as highlighted in John 3:14-15.
